rca of the issue: User's Windows Errno 10048 ('Only one usage of each socket address is normally permitted') on running run-promethius.bat is caused by Promethius already running in the background (installed as hidden-on-boot in production mode, serving the built React app from FastAPI on port 8001). The manual .bat invocation attempts to bind the same port and fails. This is an environmental duplicate-process issue, NOT an application defect — verified because the served app is fully healthy (backend 8/8, frontend 0 console errors, all PWA assets 200). Mitigation applied by main agent: run-promethius.bat is now idempotent — it detects an existing healthy instance on 8001 and exits cleanly instead of erroring.
